audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes read 'Tangle-Barbs online, level 6, first item' with no numbers, and gave Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not learnable before level 3. Neeko's level-6 spike is Pop Blossom on 120/105/90s, and Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s from 1000 range.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why rebuilt on level 3, the 12s Tangle-Barbs and the 120s Pop Blossom.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says 'Pop Blossom is a slow channel with a clear tell' and tells you to kill her during it, and it says Twilight Shroud 'breaks her clone disguise'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Pop Blossom has a SHORT preparation, and the preparation is HIDDEN if Neeko is disguised. So the one thing the page promises you - a clear tell - is exactly what a disguised Neeko denies you, and advice built on watching for it will get a player killed. Separately, nothing in Twilight Shroud's text breaks Inherent Glamour; her disguise is broken by immobilising CC, by her casting damaging spells, or by the disguise taking its healthbar in damage. And Tangle-Barbs is not a flat root: it becomes larger, faster and roots for longer once it has passed through a champion, so the second target in a line eats a much worse version.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[4].why and content mid, whys[2], whys[4], spikes[1].text and wants.you[0] now state the hidden wind-up and the escalating root, and the disguise-breaking claim is removed.

audit.why: 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s is short enough that waiting it out is not a plan - baiting it is - and saying so needs the number.

edits.before: This is where you take over. With Twilight Shroud up you turn off her kit — drop the smoke and her Q, E and clone disguise all whiff while you reposition and empowered-auto out of the smoke. At 6 your all-in is lethal: E onto her, R cast-one to dash through, then cast-two to re-dash and execute on missing HP. Pop Blossom is a slow channel with a clear tell — you delete her before the AOE stun ever pops, or you Shroud through the channel and re-engage.
edits.after: This is where you take over. With Twilight Shroud up you turn off her kit — drop the smoke and her Q and E whiff while you reposition unseen and empowered-auto out of it. At 6 your all-in is lethal: E onto her, R cast-one to dash through, then cast-two to re-dash and execute on missing HP. Pop Blossom's preparation is short and it is hidden while she is disguised, so kill her before it lands rather than waiting for a tell.

notes: The 'wait for the Pop Blossom channel tell' advice was the dangerous one here: Riot's text explicitly says the preparation is hidden while Neeko is disguised, which is precisely when she will use it on you. I also removed the claim that Twilight Shroud breaks her clone disguise — nothing in either kit supports it, and Inherent Glamour lists its own break conditions.
